scope: Operational provenance, notice, attribution and removal review for the two selected natural-code sources. Not legal advice and not a final ownership determination. The 2026-09-07 rights review covered web, math, synthetic, science and reference but never code; the code slot held a technical tokenizer-supplement summary instead. This packet fills that slot from the code audits completed since.

evidence.covers: Bounded origin/history recovery for retained Stack-Edu and Stack v3 records
Ancestor-notice recovery and Git-blob verification for purpose-selected files
Content-family hold propagation across the reviewed code cohort
Pinned upstream primary sources and the manual notice review that reads them
Host verification outcomes for the fixed Stack v3 review cohort
Frozen-group acquisition and the 44-repository / 80-file screened cohort
Stratified code-yield preflight across 11 languages and 72 strata
Source revisions, complete trees and MIT notices for four application repositories
Full retained natural-code census: 714,369 files / 476,774,847 retokenized tokens

stack_edu.declared_release: No aggregate dataset licence text is pinned in local evidence. What is pinned is per-record detected-licence metadata plus Git-verified upstream notices for a bounded cohort. The retained rows label MIT.
stack_edu.upstream: GitHub repositories surfaced through Stack-Edu metadata
stack_edu.verified_notice_example: One fully traced record: tdxutil/exceptions.py at revision 8d21cb9c9a489da4c138dd05dd578ffea7765c2a, byte- and Git-blob-verified, whose upstream LICENSE carries an MIT-style copyright and permission notice plus an additional prohibition on promotional use of the author's name. The dataset's MIT label alone did not convey that extra term.
material_gaps: 75 of 104 currently unheld origin lookups are quota-blocked at GitHub and one earlier outcome is unresolved; current unheld origin coverage is 28/104.
44 of 218 reviewed records are held by content family and stay outside training.
Retained stock is 476,774,847 tokens, 1.36% of the re-frozen 35B code preparation target, and is not representative of the full upstream release.
No execution oracle exists, so no correctness claim attaches to any file.
stack_edu.human_decision_required: Approve the original-licence allowlist and the per-file notice/attribution delivery mechanism, accept that dataset-level licence labels are not self-sufficient, and accept metadata-reliability risk for the intended release scope; or reject this source.

stack_v3.declared_release: No aggregate dataset licence text is pinned in local evidence. The probe found detected-licence metadata on 1,841 of 47,826 file entries, so most entries carry no licence label at all.
stack_v3.upstream: Public code repositories reached through Stack v3 metadata and blob storage
material_gaps: Two pinned sources return 404 and ten upstream content identities are transformed without a recorded explanation.
10 of 80 cohort files are held by known family.
The 80-file / 44-repository cohort is a bounded review sample and cannot establish full-release eligible supply.
7,084 content-ID mismatches were observed in the feasibility probe: 6,557 carry explicit redaction markers and 527 do not.
stack_v3.human_decision_required: Approve the original-licence allowlist, accept that the majority of entries lack licence metadata and must therefore be excluded rather than assumed permissive, and approve notice delivery; or reject this source.

shared_material_observations: A dataset-level licence statement governs the database or the collection, not each included file. Original per-file licences and notices continue to apply.
A detected-licence label is metadata produced by a scanner. The one record traced to its upstream notice in this evidence carried a term the label did not express.
Absence of a licence label is not permission. Entries without one must be excluded, not treated as unrestricted.
Git blob identity and byte matching establish transport and provenance, never permission.
Language, secret-scanning, deduplication and contamination gates do not resolve copyright or contractual rights, and closing them does not close this gate.
Quota-blocked origin lookups are infrastructure failures. They are not evidence that a repository is missing, unsuitable or unlicensed, and they must not be resolved by assumption.
proposed_attribution_and_removal_control: Retain dataset, revision, shard, released-content hash, repository path, recovered immutable revision, Git blob identity and detected licences in immutable attribution manifests for every admitted record.
Generate per-repository and per-file notice bundles, preserving original licence identifiers and any additional terms found in the upstream notice rather than the label.
Exclude every record whose origin, notice or licence is unresolved, including all quota-blocked lookups, until resolved by evidence.
Preserve all 44 Stack-Edu family holds and all 10 Stack v3 family holds across every stage, so a held file cannot re-enter through a different bank.
Maintain repository/path/blob/hash deny ledgers and rebuild affected packed shards rather than editing frozen evidence in place.
Name a human-controlled rights and removal contact before production acquisition.

acceptance_record_required.authority: named human with authority for the operating organization and intended use
must_record: accepted or rejected source IDs and exact evidence hashes
the approved original-licence allowlist and its exclusion default for unlabelled files
notice and attribution delivery mechanism for admitted code
research, publication, model-weight release, commercial and redistribution scope
removal contact, deny-ledger owner, response procedure and rebuild policy
date, name and signature or equivalent auditable approval

decision: No code source is approved by this automated review. It records the evidence and names the decision; the acceptance record in experiments/main-data/source-rights-acceptance.json is where a human takes it.
